summary.text: Michael Webber is a Republican state senator from Michigan who represents District 9 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A former legislative staffer and licensed insurance agent, he served in the Michigan House from 2015 to 2021.

paragraphs.text: Michael Webber was born in Rochester Hills, Michigan, where he lives, and graduated from Rochester Adams High School in 1996.

He earned a bachelor's degree in international relations and affairs from Michigan State University in 2001 and attended Georgetown University as a Michigan political leadership program fellow in 2006.

His career experience includes working as a deputy chief of staff for a state senator, an executive assistant to the chief of staff for the office of Speaker Rick Johnson, a legislative aide for state Representative John Proos, and chief of staff for state Representative Marty Knollenberg, as well as working as a licensed insurance agent.
Webber represented District 45 in the Michigan House of Representatives from 2015 to 2021, succeeding Tom McMillin, and he took office in the state Senate for District 9 on January 1, 2023.
In the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Economic and Small Business Development, Health Policy and Human Services (as minority vice chair) and Senate Regulatory Reform committees.
He advanced from the Republican primary on August 4, 2026.
